column1: # Struct layouts for TP.exe. Applied by tools/ghidra/ApplyNames.java (New Game+ skill); see re/deep-pass.md.
# Struct <TAB> size <TAB> 0xSIZE                      object size (e.g. from operator new before the ctor)
# Struct <TAB> base <TAB> BaseStruct                  flatten BaseStruct's fields in first
# - A struct named like a class namespace in names.tsv (Widget, Button, FrontEnd, CursorTracker, ...: the
#   Class::vftable lines) is that class's structure, so its __thiscall methods see `this` as Class *.
#   TPWVtables.java puts the vftable pointer at +0 of a class struct that has a size line here.
# - ctype: char, short, int, unsigned ..., byte, word, dword, float, double, bool, void, undefined4, a
#   struct name, or a Windows SDK type, with '*' and [N].
# - Notes start with H/M/L (see names.tsv) and name the report.
# ---- game clock (g_GameTimer 0x00785970). Read from the code in the deep pass (H). frame-timing.md 5.1 had
# +0x00 as "status flags" (it is an unused base clock), missed +0x44..+0x74 (offsets, saved times, the real-time
# clock at +0x50) and described fixed-step mode as capture-only: Game_Init also turns it on (32 fps) for start-up
# and the intro movies, until front-end init turns it off; in the park it is on only while g_CaptureEveryFrame.
